content.rendered:
It’s that time of year again. A new background check must be completed for each new school year. Are you planning to volunteer in your student’s classroom this year? Are you planning to attend classroom parties? Would you like to be a classroom chaperone on school field trips? In order to do any of these, you will need to complete a background check first. The process is so simple and takes less than 5 minutes to complete. Complete the process now and you will be ready to go for the entire year.
